summary: Dependency resolved from unpinned GitHub repo enables install-time code execution
details: package.json declares `libsignal` with source `github:wanzchil/libsignal-node` — a bare GitHub owner/repo reference with no commit SHA, tag, or version pin. On `npm install`, npm clones and installs whatever the current HEAD of that repository returns and runs any lifecycle scripts it contains, with no registry integrity check. Whoever controls the `wanzchil/libsignal-node` repository can therefore change the code that executes on every installer's machine at install time, at any point after this package is published. The remainder of the package is a WhatsApp/Baileys-style library; an exported `checkWhatsAppBanStatus(phone,...)` helper GETs `https://kyuux-r.indevs.in/api/check-whatsapp` with a caller-supplied phone number, which is a user-invoked third-party lookup rather than automatic behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
